mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing the nursery outflow into contact with the tail cloud was most worthwhile: it connected the two routes and showed the cloud's edge being stripped.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final two combinations were fairly predictable, since each was the only available action, though they resolved the clump question.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outflow stripped the tail cloud's edge while most of the cloud continued along the tail.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless; the offered combinations followed the gas and clumps, although the final steps left little choice.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see what becomes of the dense knot and dispersed gas; following material through different encounters was interesting.
